europaNews.title: Statement on the seventh Sanctions Coordinators Forum
europaNews.description: Today, EU Sanctions Envoy, David O’Sullivan, convened the sixth Sanctions Coordinators Forum, gathering high‑level representatives from all EU Member States and a broad coalition of international partners. Representatives of the Government of Ukraine joined for a dedicated session.

europaNews.title: Statement by Commissioner Albuquerque on the outcomes of the ninth high-level meeting on sanctions implementation
europaNews.description: High‑level representatives from Member States, alongside the Commission and the European External Action Service, came together to share best practices and success stories, and discuss challenges.

europaNews.title: EU adopts 20th package of sanctions against Russia
europaNews.description: The Commission welcomes the Council's adoption of the 20th Russia sanctions package, that puts further pressure on Russia to engage in negotiations and do so on terms acceptable for Ukraine.

europaNews.title: Commission welcomes new sanctions against Iran
europaNews.description: The restrictive measures consist of an asset freeze, travel bans to the EU, and a prohibition to make funds or economic resources available to those listed.

europaNews.title: New dynamic mechanism to lower price cap for Russian crude oil to $44,10 per barrel
europaNews.description: Today, the new automatic and dynamic mechanism for price adaptation of the oil price cap for Russian crude will be applied for the first time.

europaNews.title: Sanctions: Member States designate 41 additional vessels in Russia's shadow fleet
europaNews.description: With these new listings, a total of 597 vessels are now listed by the EU.

europaNews.title: Sanctions: The EU adopts new measures against the Russian shadow fleet ecosystem and Belarus
europaNews.description: These new measures aim at further increasing the pressure on Russia and Belarus and supporting EU's goal of achieving a just and lasting peace for Ukraine.

europaNews.title: Commission adds Russia to its list of high-risk jurisdictions to strengthen international fight against financial crime
europaNews.description: The technical assessment conducted by the Commission concluded that Russia meets the criteria to be designated as a high‑risk third country.

unNotices.title: Security Council Sanctions Committee concerning Democratic Republic of the Congo Discusses Final Report of Group of Experts
unNotices.description: On 5 June 2026, the Security Council Committee established pursuant to resolution 1533 (2004) concerning the Democratic Republic of the Congo held informal consultations during which the Coordinator of the Group of Experts presented the Group’s final report.

bbcNews.title: US lifts naval blockade as Iran's supreme leader says Trump made deal 'out of desperation'
bbcNews.description: Iran's supreme leader says he disagrees with the deal and Donald Trump signed it "out of desperation".

bbcNews.title: Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question of what the war was for
bbcNews.description: While the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has not just survived the war, it has been empowered.

bbcNews.title: What Iran and US get from deal and why both could struggle to keep it
bbcNews.description: BBC analysts assess the claims by both Washington and Tehran to have won a victory with the deal to end their war.

bbcNews.title: Moscow residents complain of black rain after largest Ukrainian attack hits oil refinery
bbcNews.description: A refinery and a shopping centre burned after almost 200 Ukrainian drones struck an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

bbcNews.title: Weapons, money and ships: How is this Iran deal different from others?
bbcNews.description: BBC Verify examines how the new deal between the US and Iran affects three key areas.

bbcNews.title: What's in the US-Iran agreement?
bbcNews.description: The 14-paragraph memo includes an end to fighting, an agreement that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, and a $300bn redevelopment package for Iran.

bbcNews.title: First Russian shadow fleet tanker enters Channel since Smyrtos boarding
bbcNews.description: Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship which left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening.

bbcNews.title: US-Iran deal leaves core sticking points unresolved - and a $300bn question
bbcNews.description: Trump has insisted the deal ensures that Iran will never buy, develop or produce a nuclear weapon. But text of the agreement falls short of that.

bbcNews.title: Will Putin change tactics after Ukrainian drone attacks?
bbcNews.description: Steve Rosenberg explains what Russia's next steps may be after frequent Ukrainian drone attacks.

bbcNews.title: Moment Trump signs US-Iran agreement at Palace of Versailles
bbcNews.description: The 14-point Memorandum of Understanding was signed at a post-G7 dinner in France.

bbcNews.title: 'Warning fire went up': Couple on board yacht describe encounter with Russian warship
bbcNews.description: The Russian frigate fired warning shots near a British retired couple on a yacht in the English Channel.

bbcNews.title: 'Do not travel' advice for Dubai dropped
bbcNews.description: Thousands of Brits were left stranded in the Middle East when the US-Iran war broke out in early 2026.

bbcNews.title: Cadbury chocolate-owner Mondelez defends staying in Russia
bbcNews.description: Mondelez boss Dirk Van de Put says it was the "right decision" to remain after the war with Ukraine.

bbcNews.title: How the Iran war affects your money and bills
bbcNews.description: The conflict in the Middle East has increased pressure on the cost of petrol, household energy bills and even food.

bbcNews.title: How could the US-Iran deal affect oil prices and the cost of food?
bbcNews.description: Experts warn the impact of the war will continue to affect the global economy for months to come.

bbcNews.title: What's happening to UK petrol and diesel prices now the US and Iran have a deal?
bbcNews.description: When the conflict began on 28 February, fuel costs jumped as the war disrupted the production and transportation of energy across the Middle East.

ajNews.title: Myanmar military airstrike kills seven civilians in Rakhine state
ajNews.description: A Myanmar military airstrike on the Rakhine state town of Kyauktaw killed at least seven civilians.

ajNews.title: Pro-Israel hawks in US criticise Iran MoU but avoid clashing with Trump
ajNews.description: Analysts warn that pro-Israel groups and politicians in Washington will likely push to derail diplomacy with Tehran.

ajNews.title: Iran’s supreme leader says approved US deal despite having ‘different’ view
ajNews.description: Iran says it has suspended Strait of Hormuz transit charges for commercial vessels for 60 days.

ajNews.title: MoU’s $300bn Iran reconstruction fund becomes US political flashpoint
ajNews.description: Trump says US will not pay for planned fund as part of Iran MoU, as lawmakers connect price tag to affordability issues.

ajNews.title: Pakistan signs US-Iran MoU
ajNews.description: Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif signed a US-Iran memorandum of understanding aimed at ending the war.

ajNews.title: US vice president slams Israel over criticism of Trump’s Iran deal
ajNews.description: JD Vance slammed members of Israel’s government for criticising US President Donald Trump over his Iran deal efforts.

occNews.title: OCC Announces Enforcement Actions for May 2026
occNews.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today released enforcement actions for May 2026.
